display_name: LoRa W24 双侧弱复谱传递（Full）
description: Test symmetric transfer risk of real source weak-detail secants on identical four-view source observations.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Strict same source-only 40000-step outer-loss W24 parent. Reset AdamW for both 1800-step continuation arms.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only
Strict 40000-step source-only initialization to both arms. Proof verified in fit.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native W24 matched source fit proof, exact reader F/complete.json binding, fixed blind control archive
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed-iteration source-only parent on same U_s cache with hidden TX and zero F, V, practical, trace or target reads. Chosen by source evidence only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at update 1800. Candidate half exceeds direct, matched half, original all-half and outer parent half on six scenes, meets all four on low urban and meets direct on clean. Eligible candidates run Full formal three shards, fixed predictions and independent truth-last.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 GPU order 0, 3, 7, 6, 2, 5; two distinct GPUs, one fit each, at least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight total compute contexts per GPU.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, invalid gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or formal prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --signed-probe after the three formal Full shards freeze.

rows.method: Four matched views, only positive probe contributes to transfer risk
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 40000 fixed parent updates plus 1800 AdamW updates, batch 16, same final joint-phase objective.

rows.method: Same four matched views, mean of positive and reverse probe transfer risks
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.

notes: Hypothesis: supervising both signed responses of the deployed half edit preserves real weak detail when positive-only probe transfer leaves the reverse response unconstrained.

Use the archived weak complex source IQ difference d between source packets in the same receiver mini-batch. On both arms use the same ordered four observations A, B, A+d, A-d, where A/B are independent legal source perturbations and both probes share A. Both use the same correctly signed source references for all four waveform and action targets. For transfer only, compare half(A+d)-half(A) and half(A)-half(A-d) against the same d in original clean coordinates. The matched control uses positive only. The candidate averages the two risks at the same total weight .30. Both report signed risks individually on the same held draws.

Strict same lawful 40000-step outer parent, batch 16, AdamW reset, 1800 steps, source U only with hidden TX, no F, V, target, practical or trace during training or freeze. No modification of the model or deployment readout.

Source V Full E104 after freeze on 300 physical packets and seven views with archived paired controls. Candidate half must exceed the four paired controls on six scenes, at least match all four on low urban and at least match direct on clean. Only if qualified, run the pre-registered three-shard 30000-packet Full matrix and independent truth-last scoring.
